headline: Battle Lines Stir Across Six Active Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns show a livelier, sharply concentrated contest than the previous edition. WeatheredExpanseHex remains the principal storm centre, with fifty-five strategic-base events in the past day and nine in the latest two hours; its ledger stands at seven Colonial and two Warden bases. CallahansPassageHex has markedly quickened, posting twenty daily events and eight in two hours, while FishermansRowHex records fifteen daily and ten recently, with five Warden and four Colonial bases. PalantineBermHex reports ten events across the day, including two in six hours, and MooringCountyHex nine, with four in the latest six-hour window; Mooring’s balance is eleven Warden to one Colonial base. StlicanShelfHex also remains unsettled, with nine daily events and four in six hours, its holdings split four Warden to five Colonial. Casualty and enlistment activity is substantial in the first three sectors, though several recent rates have cooled after earlier surges. Most other regions report no strategic-base movement in the last day, leaving these six fronts the clearest watchpoints for the next edition.
